evidence: Reads a 32-bit value from the object reached through global slot 0x700227f000+0x620 at offset +0x1ae88 and initializes output to UINT32_MAX. Only when that value is not UINT32_MAX does it resolve a context through f_7000d1cd98/f_7000205b74, obtain a player-attribute provider from global slot 0x7004650000+0x998 (using f_700183f6e4 when provider+0x30 is null), read accepted player_attribute_get_float selector 0x4c, convert it to signed int, and store it to output. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:48283-48312. No indexed or direct C caller found.

Reads context manager field +0x120, uses the value to configure the global context at 0x7004650000+0x998, then calls f_700184aca0 with configuration offset +0x50, key 1, a local output slot, and selector 4. If a provider is returned, it uses f_700183f6e4 when provider+0x30 is null, calls accepted player_attribute_get_float with selector 0x4e, converts the returned float to signed int, and stores it through the caller output pointer. The name describes the successful provider-read path; f_700184aca0 returned no provider on the other path. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:32819-32848. No indexed or direct C caller found.

Initializes output to UINT32_MAX, loads a pointer from [0x7003b25000+0x460], and continues only when the 64-bit word at pointer+0x1b060 is nonzero. It then resolves a context-manager value and player-attribute provider from global slot 0x7004650000+0x998 (falling back through f_700183f6e4 when provider+8 is null), calls accepted player_attribute_get_float with selector 0x52, converts the result to signed int, and writes it to output. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:38782-38814. No indexed or direct C caller found.

Initializes output to UINT32_MAX, loads an object pointer through global slot 0x700227f000+0x620 and offset +0x1b0a8, and requires it to be nonnull. It then requires accepted attribute_context_status_value_get(selector 0x13) to have low byte 4. On that path it passes the object to f_700066c9d0, compares the low 32-bit result with the context-manager dword at +0x120, and stores 1 when they differ or 0 when equal. Otherwise the initial UINT32_MAX remains. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:51628-51657. No indexed or direct C caller found.

Obtains an attribute-record pointer through accepted attribute_record_pointer_get_or_default using the value loaded from global root pointer+0x26198, then calls unresolved f_700183bb44 with that pointer and a context-derived value. It maps the helper result low byte to output 1 when zero, output 0 when 8, and UINT32_MAX for any other value. The output is stored through the incoming pointer. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:17345-17374. No indexed or direct C caller found.
